question: In which of the following prehistoric sites, Jadeite stone was found?
solution:
The correct answer is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jadeite stone **may have come from** China.**
 
• It is found in **Daojali Hading__, a hill located in the Brahmaputra Valley. *__Hence, option 4 is correct.__***
 
• It is located close to the routes leading to **Myanmar and China.**
 
• Here, apart from Jadeite stones,** even pestles, mortars, and stone tools were discovered.**
 
• All these discoveries point out that people were **probably growing grains and preparing food from it.**
 
• In Daojali Hading, **people also found tools made of pottery and fossil wood.**
